{{Quote|Star Tours, follow us down to the Rebel hangar. You'll be safe there.|N-1 starfighter pilot|<ref name="ST2" />}}
This '''N-1 starfighter pilot''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. During a [[Skirmish over Naboo (Galactic Civil War)|battle]] with [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]], the pilot and two others escorted a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency [[StarSpeeder 1000|vessel]] down through the atmosphere of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] where it could deliver a [[Unidentified Rebel spy|Rebel spy]] to a safe hangar. However, she was eventually shot down by the pursuing Vulture droids, forcing the vessel to dive into one of Naboo's lakes.<ref name="ST2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Since the [[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue|''Star Tours'']] attraction visits one of three different planets during each segment of the ride, this starfighter pilot does not always appear.<ref name="ST2" />
